'''2010 Malastare Regionals Mike Samaniego LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Samaniego]] at [[2010 Malastare Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
